sheetUrl.title: Google Sheet URL
sheetUrl.description: URL of the Google Sheet containing usernames (Column A) and messages (Column B).

cookieString.title: X.com Cookie String
cookieString.description: Raw cookie string for authentication (optional if auth_token/ct0 are provided).

googleApiKey.title: Google API Key
googleApiKey.description: API Key for accessing private Google Sheets (optional).

messagesPerRun.title: Messages Per Run
messagesPerRun.description: Maximum number of messages to send in a single execution.

delaySeconds.title: Base Delay (Seconds)
delaySeconds.description: Base delay between sending messages (will be randomized +/- 5 seconds).

pinCode.title: DM PIN Code
pinCode.description: Optional PIN code if X requires it for DM recovery.
